title: 最
teacherNotes: Production C complete-package handoff for L320 最. Approved sentences are fixed. Latest origin/main is complete through L317 粉; L318 哪 and L319 些 are not merged at claim time, so this package depends on L318 and L319 and uses 哪/些 as provisional learned characters. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate.

approvedSentences.text: 這些粉彩畫，哪一張最好看？
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這些粉彩畫哪一張最好看
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist girl identity. On the table are several completed pastel drawings, each with different content and all looking attractive. The girl is comparing or choosing one of the drawings. The image must clearly show "these pastel drawings" and the question of which one looks best. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 有些衣服沒乾，要最後才能收。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 有些衣服沒乾要最後才能收
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist mother and recurring protagonist girl identities. Show a drying rack with several pieces of clothing. Some clothes are already dry and folded nearby, while some are still visibly damp and hanging, so they cannot be put away yet. Mother or the girl is checking which clothes are still wet. The image must clearly show "some clothes are not dry" and "they can only be collected last." No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.

Use the recurring protagonist girl identity. She is looking at a drawing with flowers or clouds where the pink area is still not enough. She holds a pink drawing material and is about to add a little more pink. The image must clearly suggest adjusting the picture by adding more pink. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.

Use the recurring protagonist girl identity. She may stand with the recurring 「你」 young boy at a safe fork in the road. There are two or three different paths ahead, and one path clearly leads to a school building while the other paths go elsewhere. The children look like they are deciding which road reaches the school. Do not use written signs, arrows, road labels, numbers, or text; the school should be shown by building appearance only. Keep the scene safe and child-friendly.

approvedSentences.text: 這一道是媽媽最拿手的菜。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這一道是媽媽最拿手的菜
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist mother and recurring protagonist girl identities. Mother is serving one homemade dish at the family table, and the girl looks happy or expectant. The table may include rice and a few simple side dishes, but the focus should be the dish mother is presenting as her specialty. Do not depict a competition, restaurant advertisement, written menu, labels, or text.
